newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italian firms falls 3.9pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italian firms falls 3.9pct yr/yr.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employers fell 3.9 percent year-on-year in February, the national statistics instiute Istat said on Wednesday.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 96.4 (1995=100) in February, with employment up 0.1 percent on January this year.
Hours worked per employee were down 4.1 percent compared to February 1996 after a 5.4 percent drop year-on-year in January.
Istat said the sector most affected in February by the fall in employment was the service industry, while the industrial sector made slight gains on the previous month. --Rome Newsroom +39 6 678-2501
